hints.title: Priority Cascade Matching
hints.text: Queries match with three priority tiers: exact match first, case-insensitive match second, and vowel-error match third.

hints.title: Canonical Vowel Key Masking
hints.text: Replace every vowel in lowercase words with a wildcard placeholder like asterisk to handle vowel variations.

hints.title: Three Tier Lookup Table
hints.text: Store words in exact set. In a map, store lowercase word to first original word seen. In another map, store devoweled lowercase word to first original word seen. For each query, test exact, then lowercase, then devoweled, else return empty string.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: W: number of words in wordlist
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the wordlist for each query sequentially takes O(W * Q * L) operations, causing Time Limit Exceeded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hashing exact words, lowercase forms, and masked vowel keys enables O(L) resolution per query with linear auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should preserve the first appearance rule for case-insensitive and vowel-insensitive ties using setdefault.
complexity.notes: Y is treated as a consonant by the problem specification.
